channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

productId.description: Visible marketplace Product Id / primary id.

productIds.description: Visible marketplace Product Id / primary id values.

variationProductId.description: Visible variation Product Id / primary id when needed.

variationProductIds.description: Visible variation Product Id / primary id values when needed.
